supersedes.reason: Claude independent design audit rejected sequence 1 / attempt 1 creation of all 28 targets because it defeats per-sequence scope isolation and contaminates firstTryPassRate.

constraints: Each createTargets list must be an ordered subset of that sequence's final allowedChangeTargets.
The union of all createTargets lists must exactly equal Decision J scope.changeTargets.
No target may occur in more than one createTargets list.
A later sequence may modify an already-created target only when that target is in its allowedChangeTargets; it must not create it again.
The exact per-sequence allocation remains unresolved in this candidate and requires independent review plus a separate owner approval before finalization.
No firstComponentFullCreate field is permitted in v2.

constraints: Derive directories from the ordered createTargets list for the return; do not accept an independently entered bootstrap directory list.
Every derived directory must be relative and either equal site or be under site/.
MyBrain/, .git, .figma-gate, p3-drafts, absolute paths, and parent traversals are forbidden.
The final return plan and handoff protocol must bind the same derived directory policy.
Write the intended per-directory journal entry before mkdir; never create a directory before its rollback intent is journaled.
Record createdByThisTransaction for every directory actually created by the transaction.
Rollback processes journaled directories in reverse order.
Rollback may remove a directory only when createdByThisTransaction is true and the directory is empty at rollback time.
If a rollback candidate directory is non-empty, leave it in place, report it, and fail closed; do not force-delete it.
A directory not recorded in the journal is unknown and must never be deleted by recovery, including after a mkdir-before-journal crash.

negativeTestRequirements: N-1: The retained v4 fixture with firstComponentFullCreate.paths outside that sequence's allowedChangeTargets fails; v2 also fails if a legacy firstComponentFullCreate field is supplied.
N-2: The retained v4 fixture where sequence >= 2 creates a file fails; under v2, a sequence >= 2 may create only a target in its approved createTargets allocation, and every other creation fails.
N-3: The retained v4 fixture that enables firstComponentFullCreate at sequence 1 / attempt >= 2 fails; under v2, any bootstrap creation at attempt >= 2 fails.
N-4: createTargets do not partition all 28 frozen changeTargets exactly once fails.
N-5: A derived bootstrap directory outside site/ or containing traversal/forbidden roots fails.
N-6: Protocol and return-plan createTargets/derived-directory policies differ fails.
N-7: Rollback finds a non-empty transaction-created directory, preserves it, reports it, and fails.
N-8: Recovery never deletes a directory absent from the journal.
N-9: A crash after mkdir but before the journal state is complete leaves unknown directories untouched and fails closed.
N-10: v1 journal recovery through v2 code passes.
N-11: A v2 journal missing required fields fails.
N-12: Condition-local return authority packet manifest, attachment hash, or identityLeakScan mismatch fails.
N-13: Baseline and current finalized handoff protocols that are not byte-identical fail.
finalizationRequirements: Obtain a new independent design review of this v2 candidate before helper or protocol implementation.
Resolve the exact per-sequence allowedChangeTargets and createTargets allocation in final records; this candidate intentionally contains none.
Add and pass the listed pure-validation/fixture negative tests without lifecycle, role launch, browser, Figma, or P-11 execution.
Obtain a separate owner approval for the actual final bytes and approval timestamp before setting ownerApproved:true.
Keep baseline and current finalized protocol bytes identical and preserve attachment-only boundaries.
